def fabric(nn, gpus):

    sw=[N+i for i in range(nn)]
    sp=[N+nn, N+nn+1]
    links=[]; seen=set()
    def add(u,v):

        seen.add(kk); links.append((u,v,50))

            add(a*gpus+b, sw[a])
    for a in range(nn):
        add(sw[a], sp[0]); add(sw[a], sp[1])
    return N+nn+2, links
